Fresh sourdough, baked every morning

We bake sourdough, rye and seeded loaves every morning in our shop on Mill Lane, Exampletown. Orders placed before nine are ready by noon. We use local flour and we list every supplier on our about page. Our team has baked here since 2012 and answers the phone from six in the morning.
